# tebib_nat_gateway (Resource)

A NAT gateway: outbound internet for VMs in a VPC that have no public IP. Give it a public IP with `public_ip_id` or a `tebib_public_ip_association`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tebib_public_ip" "nat" {
  name = "nat"
}

resource "tebib_nat_gateway" "main" {
  name         = "main"
  subnet_id    = tebib_subnet.web.id
  public_ip_id = tebib_public_ip.nat.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name, unique among the project's NAT gateways. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `subnet_id` (String) Subnet the gateway sits in. Changing it replaces the gateway.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description, at most 255 characters. Default: empty.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID (`p-...`). Default: the provider's `project`. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `public_ip_id` (String) Public IP for outbound traffic, set at creation. Leave it out to associate one later with `tebib_public_ip_association`.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags (key-value pairs). IAM policies can match them. Default: none.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) NAT gateway ID (`nat-...`).
- `lan_ip` (String) The gateway's address in the subnet.
- `public_address` (String) Its public IPv4 address, once it has one.
- `state` (String) Lifecycle state: `active` once ready (or `error`).
- `status_message` (String) What the platform last said about the resource.
- `trn` (String) TebibHost resource name (TRN), for IAM policies.
- `vpc_id` (String) The gateway's VPC.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import tebib_nat_gateway.main nat-abc123
```
